body.name: K3audit
body.def: \(\mathfrak A_3=(w,W,B,D,R,N_B)\) with \(w\in(0,1)^3\), \(\mathbf 1_3^{\mathsf T}w=1\), the \(w_j\) not all equal, \(W=\operatorname{diag}(w_1,w_2,w_3)\), \(B\in\mathbb R^{9\times3}\) of full column rank, \(Bw>0\) entrywise, \(D=\operatorname{diag}(Bw)\), \(R=D^{-1}BW\), and \(N_B=I_9-D^{-1}B(B^{\mathsf T}D^{-1}B)^{-1}B^{\mathsf T}\)
body.role: Exact symbolic nonconstant-posterior audit of the first cell elimination at \(K=3\).
